units.rawText: Hello, Caretaker. Are you also here to help feed everyone today? Before that... today's... hmm... an anniversary that holds no special meaning.

units.rawText: The bonus is... ding-ding! A ticket for a zoo tour with Taisch. Today, the Caretaker gets to join Taisch on a relaxing tour of the zoo.
